description: FamilySearch place data for the bare state 'Pennsylvania' — the companion fixture place-distance-within-pennsylvania.json already anticipates an agent resolving this state-level standard place, but no place_search fixture produced it, so a legitimate 'Pennsylvania' lookup (e.g. to standardize a death certificate's stated birthplace) hit fixture_not_found instead of the county-level place-search-schuylkill-county.json.
